description: Search Taiwan government procurement tenders (政府電子採購網 / PCC) by title keyword, via the g0v community mirror. Pass a keyword (Chinese or English, e.g. "電腦", "AI", "消防"). Returns matching tenders with tender id (unit_id + job_number), title, agency (機關名稱), announcement type, date, and category. Use taiwan_get_tender with a result's unit_id + job_number for full detail. Third-party mirror; results are best-effort.

query.description: Title keyword to search, e.g. "電腦" (computer), "消防" (fire safety), "AI".
